questions.question: You can search and find information on any subject using the ___.
questions.explanation: The internet is a global network that allows you to search and find information on any subject using search engines and websites.

questions.question: Examples of Wiki's are ___ and ___.
questions.explanation: Wikis are collaborative websites. Examples include Wikibooks (a collection of educational textbooks) and Wikinews (a news source), along with Wikipedia, Wiktionary, and others in the Wiki family.

questions.question: You can type keywords inside the ___ to find what you are looking for.
questions.explanation: A search box is a text field where you type keywords to search for information on websites or search engines like Google.

questions.question: Wikipedia is a free ___.
questions.explanation: Wikipedia is a free online encyclopedia that anyone can edit and access. It contains millions of articles on various topics.

questions.question: Virus is a programme that can get into the computer and cause problems.
questions.explanation: A computer virus is malicious software that can infect your computer and cause various problems like data loss, slow performance, or system crashes.

questions.question: Virus can protect your computer.
questions.explanation: Viruses are harmful programs that damage computers. They do not protect your computer. Anti-virus programs protect your computer from viruses.

questions.question: Virus can not steal information from computers.
questions.explanation: Viruses can steal personal information, passwords, and important data from your computer. This is why it's important to use anti-virus software.

questions.question: An Anti-virus programme can protect your computer.
questions.explanation: Anti-virus programs are designed to detect, prevent, and remove viruses and other malicious software from your computer, keeping it safe.

questions.question: Always give personal information to strangers when you chat with them.
questions.explanation: You should never give personal information (like your address, phone number, or school name) to strangers online. This is an important safety rule.

questions.question: What is the storage device that cannot store a movie?
questions.explanation: A CD (Compact Disc) typically holds 700MB of data, which is not enough to store a full movie. DVDs, USB drives, and external hard disks have much larger storage capacities suitable for movies.

questions.question: What is the oldest type of printer?
questions.explanation: The dot matrix printer is the oldest type of printer listed here. It uses a print head that strikes an ink ribbon to print dots on paper, creating characters and images.

questions.question: What device can be used to capture your voice?
questions.explanation: A microphone is an input device that captures sound and voice. It converts sound waves into electrical signals that the computer can process.

questions.question: Your family photo can be saved as
questions.explanation: Photos and pictures are saved as image files with extensions like .jpg, .png, or .gif. These formats are designed specifically for storing visual images.

questions.question: Choose the correct pair of colours used in the inkjet printer.
questions.explanation: Inkjet printers use four basic ink colors: Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, and Black (CMYK). Black and yellow are both part of this standard color set.

questions.question: What is the storage device that can be found in a smartphone?
questions.explanation: Smartphones use memory cards (like SD cards or microSD cards) for additional storage. CDs, DVDs, and external hard disks are too large to fit in smartphones.

questions.question: To access the internet, you need to have a
questions.explanation: A web browser (like Chrome, Firefox, or Safari) is software that allows you to access and view websites on the internet.

questions.question: An e-mail needs to contain
questions.explanation: While emails can include pictures, videos, and emoticons, the most important required element is a subject title that describes what the email is about.

questions.question: Choose the correct folder name?
questions.explanation: Folder names cannot contain special characters like ?, <, >, or #. 'My Photo' is a valid folder name that follows naming rules.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a web browser?
questions.explanation: Internet Explorer is a web browser. File Explorer is for managing files on your computer, while memory stick and dot matrix are hardware devices.

questions.question: Which of the following information you should not share with a stranger?
questions.explanation: Personal information like your home address should never be shared with strangers online as it could compromise your safety. General preferences like favorite food or color are less risky.

questions.question: If you don't want a file any longer, you can
questions.explanation: Deleting a file removes it from your computer when you no longer need it. Editing, copying, and pasting are for modifying or duplicating files.

questions.question: CD is the evolution of DVD.
questions.explanation: DVD (Digital Versatile Disc) is actually the evolution of CD (Compact Disc). DVDs came after CDs and have more storage capacity.

questions.question: Architectural plans can be printed using a thermal printer.
questions.explanation: Architectural plans are large format documents that require a plotter to print, not a thermal printer. Thermal printers are typically used for receipts.

questions.question: A sub folder is a folder inside a folder.
questions.explanation: A subfolder (or subdirectory) is a folder that exists inside another folder, helping to organize files in a hierarchical structure.

questions.question: A file in your computer can be transferred to your mobile phone.
questions.explanation: Files can be transferred between computers and mobile phones using various methods like USB cables, Bluetooth, cloud storage, or email.

questions.question: Microsoft Word is a word processor.
questions.explanation: Microsoft Word is a word processing application used for creating, editing, and formatting text documents.

questions.question: Every file does not have a file extension.
questions.explanation: Every file has a file extension (like .docx, .jpg, .mp3) that indicates the file type and which program should open it.

questions.question: A computer virus cannot steal your information.
questions.explanation: Computer viruses can steal personal information, passwords, and sensitive data from your computer. This is why cybersecurity is important.

questions.question: You can zoom in and zoom out your document on the screen.
questions.explanation: Most applications allow you to zoom in (make content larger) or zoom out (make content smaller) to view documents more comfortably on screen.

questions.question: You can use emoticons to show your feelings in a chat room.
questions.explanation: Emoticons (like :) or :() are symbols used in chat rooms and messages to express emotions and feelings in text-based communication.

questions.question: An anti-virus program is one of the most powerful weapons to protect your computer.
questions.explanation: Anti-virus software is essential for protecting your computer from viruses, malware, and other security threats by detecting and removing harmful programs.

questions.question: File explorer is an example of a web browser.
questions.explanation: File Explorer is a file management tool for browsing files on your computer. Web browsers (like Chrome or Firefox) are used to access the internet.

questions.question: You cannot use search engines to find information.
questions.explanation: Search engines like Google, Bing, and Yahoo are specifically designed to help you find information on the internet by searching through billions of web pages.

questions.question: ___ is the most common search engine.
questions.explanation: Google is the world's most popular and widely used search engine, processing billions of searches every day.

questions.question: You can use ___ web browser to search on the internet.
questions.explanation: Safari is a web browser developed by Apple that can be used to search and browse the internet, along with other browsers like Chrome and Firefox.

questions.question: ___ is a set of rules for proper online behaviour.
questions.explanation: Netiquette (network etiquette) refers to the rules and guidelines for polite and appropriate behavior when communicating online.

questions.question: ___ uses a long narrow paper to print.
questions.explanation: Thermal printers use long rolls of narrow thermal paper and are commonly used in cash registers, ATMs, and receipt printing.

questions.question: ___ is a virtual encyclopedia.
questions.explanation: Wikipedia is a free online encyclopedia that contains millions of articles written and edited collaboratively by volunteers around the world.

questions.question: A web address is also called ___.
questions.explanation: URL stands for Uniform Resource Locator, which is the address of a webpage on the internet (like www.example.com).

questions.question: You must be ___ online, just like in real life.
questions.explanation: It's important to be polite and respectful when communicating online, just as you would be in face-to-face interactions.

questions.question: ___ are the list of rules for proper behaviour on the internet.
questions.explanation: Netiquette (internet etiquette) is a set of rules that guide proper and respectful behavior when using the internet and communicating online.

questions.question: ___ is a communication method.
questions.explanation: Instant messaging allows people to send text messages to each other in real-time over the internet, like WhatsApp or text messaging.

questions.question: Never use ___ in chat rooms.
questions.explanation: Using bad language or inappropriate words in chat rooms is disrespectful and goes against proper online behavior (netiquette).

questions.question: Always use a ___ for emails.
questions.explanation: A subject title tells the recipient what the email is about, making it easier to organize and understand the purpose of the message.

questions.question: Match: 25 add 35
questions.explanation: In calculator programs, the plus symbol (+) is used to represent addition. So '25 add 35' is written as '25 + 35 ='.

questions.question: Match: 24 divided by 8
questions.explanation: In calculator programs, the forward slash (/) is used to represent division. So '24 divided by 8' is written as '24 / 8 ='.

questions.question: Match: 78 subtract 12
questions.explanation: In calculator programs, the minus symbol (−) is used to represent subtraction. So '78 subtract 12' is written as '78 − 12 ='.

questions.question: Match: 5 multiply by 4
questions.explanation: In calculator programs, the asterisk (*) is used to represent multiplication. So '5 multiply by 4' is written as '5 * 4 ='.

questions.question: The biggest storage device is ___.
questions.explanation: Hard Disk Drives (HDDs) have the largest storage capacity among common storage devices, capable of storing terabytes of data.

questions.question: The storage device that can store or transfer data quickly is ___.
questions.explanation: USB Flash Drives (also called memory sticks) can quickly transfer data between computers using USB ports, making them very convenient.

questions.question: CD is known as ___.
questions.explanation: CD stands for Compact Disc. It's a flat, circular disc used to store digital data, music, or computer files.

questions.question: DVD is the evolution of ___.
questions.explanation: DVD (Digital Versatile Disc) evolved from CD technology with much greater storage capacity, allowing it to store movies and large files.

questions.question: The storage device that can be used in Digital Cameras is ___.
questions.explanation: Memory cards (like SD cards) are small, portable storage devices used in digital cameras, smartphones, and other portable devices to store photos and data.

questions.question: A suitable file name for your family photo is ___.
questions.explanation: File names should be descriptive and not contain special characters like ?, !, <, >, or *. 'My family' is a clear and valid file name.

questions.question: What is shown by a folder icon?
questions.explanation: The folder icon represents a container for organizing and storing files on your computer, similar to a physical folder that holds papers.

questions.question: If you don't need a file any longer you can ___ it.
questions.explanation: Deleting a file removes it from your computer when you no longer need it, freeing up storage space.

questions.question: The extension of the file 'My country.docx' is ___.
questions.explanation: File extensions appear after the dot in a filename and indicate the file type. .docx is a Microsoft Word document format.

questions.question: A sub folder is a ___ inside a ___.
questions.explanation: A subfolder is a folder contained within another folder, helping to organize files in a hierarchical structure.

questions.question: The printer that uses laser rays to print on paper is ___.
questions.explanation: Laser printers use laser beams to create an image on a drum, which then transfers toner (powdered ink) onto paper to produce high-quality prints.

questions.question: The oldest type of printer is ___.
questions.explanation: Dot matrix printers are the oldest type of printer still in use. They print by striking pins against an ink ribbon to create characters made of dots.

questions.question: ___ is used for printing architectural plans and advertising banners.
questions.explanation: Plotters are large-format printers designed to print wide graphics like architectural plans, engineering drawings, and advertising banners.

questions.question: ___ is used in shops, banks and restaurants.
questions.explanation: Thermal printers are commonly used to print receipts in shops, banks, and restaurants because they are fast and quiet.

questions.question: ___ uses cyan, yellow, magenta and black ink colours.
questions.explanation: Inkjet printers spray tiny droplets of liquid ink onto paper. They use four colors (CMYK: Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, and Black) to create full-color images.

questions.question: Based on the July 2025 exam marking scheme question (i)
questions.explanation: This question is from the July 2025 examination. The specific question text was not available in the PDF, but the answer key shows option (a) is correct.

questions.question: What is a suitable name for a birthday folder?
questions.explanation: Folder names should be descriptive and not contain special characters. Simple names like 'Birthday' or 'My Birthday' are appropriate.

questions.question: Identify file types: audio file, image file, video file
questions.correct_answer: Correctly identify all three file types
questions.explanation: Different file types include audio files (like .mp3 for music), image files (like .jpg for photos), and video files (like .mp4 for movies).

questions.question: What is the file name of 'My School.docx'?
questions.explanation: The file name is the part before the extension. In 'My School.docx', 'My School' is the file name and '.docx' is the extension.

questions.question: What is the file extension of 'My School.docx'?
questions.explanation: The file extension is the part after the dot that indicates the file type. .docx is the extension for Microsoft Word documents.

questions.question: ___ is a place where people can chat online in real-time.
questions.explanation: A chat room is a virtual space on the internet where multiple people can communicate with each other in real-time through text messages.

questions.question: ___ uses laser rays to print high-quality documents.
questions.explanation: Laser printers use laser technology to produce high-quality, fast prints, commonly used in offices for text documents.

questions.question: Computer ___ are harmful programs that can damage your computer.
questions.explanation: Computer viruses are malicious programs that can infect your computer, steal data, or cause damage to your files and system.

questions.question: ___ is the oldest type of printer that uses pins to print.
questions.explanation: Dot matrix printers are the oldest printer type, using a print head with pins that strike an ink ribbon to create characters.

questions.question: ___ are cameras connected to computers for video calls.
questions.explanation: Webcams are video cameras that connect to computers or are built into laptops, used for video calls, online meetings, and recording videos.

questions.question: ___ is a pointing device with a ball on top.
questions.explanation: A trackball is an input device with a ball that you roll with your fingers to move the cursor on screen, similar to an upside-down mouse.

questions.question: A ___ helps you find information on the internet.
questions.explanation: Search engines like Google, Bing, and Yahoo help you find information by searching through billions of web pages based on your keywords.

questions.question: Computers can understand many programming ___.
questions.explanation: Programming languages (like Python, Java, or JavaScript) are special languages used to give instructions to computers and create software.

questions.question: Identify the device: trackball
questions.explanation: A trackball is a pointing device that has a ball on top which you rotate with your fingers to control the cursor.

questions.question: Identify the device: Memory card
questions.explanation: Memory cards are small portable storage devices used in cameras, phones, and other devices to store data.

questions.question: Identify the device: Digitizer/Graphic Tablet
questions.explanation: A digitizer or graphic tablet is an input device that allows artists and designers to draw directly on a surface using a special pen.

questions.question: Identify the device: Dot Matrix Printer
questions.explanation: A dot matrix printer is the oldest type of printer that uses pins striking an ink ribbon to create characters.

questions.question: Identify the device: Joystick
questions.explanation: A joystick is an input device with a stick that can be moved in different directions, commonly used for gaming.

questions.question: Name two portable computing devices.
questions.explanation: Smartphones and tablet computers are portable computing devices you can carry and use anywhere, unlike desktop computers.

questions.question: What device can capture moving images?
questions.explanation: A video camera records moving images (videos), unlike a regular camera which captures still photographs.

questions.question: Name two Virtual Reality (VR) devices.
questions.explanation: VR (Virtual Reality) devices like VR gloves and VR headsets allow users to interact with and experience computer-generated 3D environments.

questions.question: Name two types of portable computers.
questions.explanation: Laptops and notebook computers are portable PCs that can be carried and used in different locations, running on battery power.

questions.question: Name software for creating text documents.
questions.explanation: Microsoft Word is word processing software used to create, edit, and format text documents like letters, reports, and essays.

questions.question: Name software for creating presentations.
questions.explanation: Microsoft PowerPoint is presentation software used to create slideshows with text, images, and animations for presentations.
